articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Paul Boag)
articles.description: We’ve been working on something new! We’ve teamed up for a **new small community** for people doing UX-inside organizations — with weekly calls and a shared library of the business cases, templates, and research plans that have actually worked for other folks. [Jump to details](https://uxinsiders.boagworld.com/).
articles.title: A New Community For In-House UX People

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Eric Bailey)
articles.description: As LLM chat patterns become more widespread, making them accessible is essential to ensuring everyone can access the information, tools, and opportunities they offer. Drawing on his work improving these interfaces, Eric Bailey shares practical ways to make chat-based experiences on the web more accessible and usable for people who rely on assistive technology.
articles.title: Making Immersive LLM Chat Experiences More Accessible

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Gabriel Shoyombo)
articles.description: Replacing JavaScript with a modern CSS feature can simplify a piece of code while making the wider application harder to reason about. Gabriel Shoyombo explores what happens when logic is split between CSS and JavaScript, sharing practical guidance to help you keep complexity in check during migration.
articles.title: Modern CSS Might Make Your Front-End More Complex

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Cosima Mielke)
articles.description: Let’s kick of November with a new collection of desktop wallpapers! Designed by creatives from across the globe, the wallpapers come in a variety of screen resolutions and can be downloaded for free. Enjoy!
articles.title: A Spark Of Color In November’s Gray (2026 Wallpapers Edition)

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Vitaly Friedman)
articles.description: A closer look at accordion icons, why split menus are harmful, and why it’s better not to have icons and text labels link to different actions. Plus, why the caret is the safest icon choice. You’ll find more [useful guides](https://www.smashingmagazine.com/category/guides/) and [online workshops](https://smashingconf.com/online-workshops) here on Smashing Magazine, so make sure to browse and explore.
articles.title: Accordion Icons: Which Work Best?

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Brecht De Ruyte)
articles.description: Design systems thrive on consistency, so where does randomness fit in? Through playful demos of organic typography, bouncing letters, and splayed cards, Brecht De Ruyte shows how the new CSS `random()` function brings a little imperfection to the web without JavaScript libraries or preprocessor loops that generate hundreds of lines of static CSS.
articles.title: Embracing Playful Imperfection With The CSS `random()` Function

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Paul Boag)
articles.description: What can digital transformation teach us about AI adoption? Paul Boag revisits his book Digital Adaptation to show how lessons from the past can help organizations navigate the challenges of AI today. - AI - Workflow - Business
articles.title: Is Your Organization Messing Up AI Adoption?

這四樣東西構成了我那個年代的大學青春文化：命運  大訂單、艦隊收藏、披頭四、平克弗洛伊德。

作為英語系學生，在我遁入Linux與開源軟體計算機的世界之前，大學生活可以說是幾乎繞著他們打轉，譬如我可以一邊打甲級難度的艦隊季節活動，然後聽Atom Heart Mother，再切換到blender做軍機的3D建模。Pink Floyd的搖滾樂當作業用BGM很方便，因為一首歌都10分鐘以上XD

articles.author: infoivonblog.nkfjt@aleeas.com (Ivon Huang)
articles.description:
用GCam這種自動修圖的相機APP拍照算不算作弊？
看過去我Sony中階Xperia 10 V手機拍的照片，好漂亮的幾張啊，然而原廠的很難拍出這種效果，幾乎是GCam的功勞，Sony只負責提供硬體，小巧好握的機身。





因為我奉行Parrhesia原則（直言不諱，即使說出真相可能帶來風險或負面後果，仍勇於坦誠發言，將說真話視為一種道德責任 by 傅柯），用GCam常常拍出遠超Sony和小米原廠相機效果的照片…如果我分享照片，應該標註用GCam拍的嗎。就像使用AI開發軟體、用AI繪圖，應該憑良心自行揭露。
articles.title: 用GCam拍照算不算作弊？我對用GCam拍照想法的轉變

articles.description:
講到最好的Android相機APP，Ivon認為還得是Open Camera莫屬。

它提供拍照與錄影功能，但是…不僅於此！
很少有相機APP是開源的，然後又提供這麼多自訂功能，讓人把玩。如果你追求自由開源的相機方案，不想被各家廠商的閉源APP綁架，那麼你值得嘗試Open Camera！

Android開源相機App又增添新的生力軍了，過去我比較常用的是Open Camera，跨品牌通用。
articles.title: 光子相機：手動控制與調色濾鏡的Android開源拍照APP

articles.description:
Android手機對第三方相機支援度挺混亂的，很依賴個別廠商實作，且幾乎沒有第三方介入的餘地
看看原廠 vs 第三方相機品質。


所謂第三方相機，是相對於手機系統內建的相機而言，非原廠開發的相機APP。
不是有很多人反映Instagram相機的限時動態在Android拍起來很難看嗎，iPhone就不會。致使Android用戶必須用系統相機拍完再上傳。
articles.title: Android手機第三方相機拍照難看，可能要到CameraX普及才解決

articles.description:
根據我的觀察，Sony手機的選色審美一直都是沒問題的，美感設計一直在線。低調，耐看，其實是Sony手機的一項優點。
你看看啊，自2019年以來，1系列和5系列都是偏低調的顏色。Sony手機不會推出iPhone三星那種高飽和度的顏色，也甚少推出玫瑰金。Xperia 1 VIII出現的金色款可說是一種稀有的產物。正如iPhone 17推出的宇宙橙，大膽鮮明的配色，成為一種張揚炫耀用的東西。
articles.title: Sony手機外觀顏色的設計是很有水準的

articles.author: infoivonblog.nkfjt@aleeas.com (Ivon Huang)
articles.description:
早知道，還是原道？
在我用原道醬的小卡打了一發之後，該來寫寫原道耳機二代的使用心得了。

NiceHCK YD30原道二代
哇靠，超好聽的
原道耳機是高CP值的中國品牌耳機。有句話說，早知道還是原道。從十年前就紅遍兩岸的耳機圈的神物。他們說，不到人民幣50塊的耳機能吊打一萬塊的耳機，聽了會讓你瞬間從HiFi退燒，覺得追求高階耳機都是圖個啥呀。因為各種刷梗而爆紅。
articles.title: 真的不錯聽耶，NiceHCK YD30原道耳機二代使用心得
